nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV )is a respiratory virus causing cough, fever, and congestion, especially in kids and elderly. In China, HMPV made up 6.2% of respiratory cases in late 2024. Globally, it's around 4.7%. Prevent it with good hygiene: wash hands, cover coughs. #HMPvirus https://t.co/NDidFl1ALC
